text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to a shrine with Wonder Acute, who 
hadn't been in the best condition lately.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Shrines sure are nice—solemn and peaceful. 
I can see why the pigeons come here to 
sunbathe~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I guess this is what they mean when they 
say something cleanses the soul."
choice_data_list:
With this, I should be able to shake off 
this slump.

With this, I should be able to shake off 
this slump!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I only came to visit the shrine 
today to calm my nerves, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just going to let the gods know my 
determination to do my best."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I'm out of sorts, I gotta fix it 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Do what you can, step by step. And when 
you feel like giving up, just grit your 
teeth and endure.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you can just get into the right frame 
of mind to work hard, that alone is more 
than enough to be grateful for.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we go pay our respects at 
the shrine?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my best to get back in shape, so 
please watch over me."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Phew, guess that about does it.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hellooo! Did you come to pray too, 
Umamusume big sis?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Indeed it is. What an energetic child. 
Make sure you pay your respects properly, 
now~.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: ? Are you... an Umamusume's grandma?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No, no, 'Big Sister' is just fine. Make 
sure you play safe and don't get hurt, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks! Good luck with your running 
too, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...My heart feels so light and refreshed. 
I think I can do my best now.
choice_data_list:
Feels like we've got the blessing of the 
gods.

Feels like we've got the blessing of the 
gods.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Indeed, that may very well be the case.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Wonder Acute's spirits lifted, and 
she got back into top form.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, dear God. I'll come visit 
again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Looks like we're in for a shower.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I left the window in my dorm room 
open!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, rain began to fall and soaked 
the room, and Wonder Acute's condition 
failed to recover.
